text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: It feels like ancient history now…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "I look forward to hearing you sing one day." Aw…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (I don't receive nearly as many fan letters as I did after my debut, but…)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (There are still people out there rooting for me.)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: …The moon's so bright today. Some of the stars have faded.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Haha, what am I doing? As if I could ever reach them…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (Wait, that voice…)

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text: Can't believe I lost again… Sniffle. I hate this.

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text: I was going to win… and sing my thanks to them… Today was supposed to be the day!

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text: Why… why can't I just—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I've never seen her like that before. So even she cries sometimes…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (Please, if there's anyone listening up there, don't let her tears be shed in vain.)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (When she wins, I'll be cheering from the front row. I'll scream until my throat goes dry.)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (Because if she just had a chance, I know it'd be a magical concert like no other…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: More and more people know about the Grand Concert now. Our efforts must be paying off.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: We hope you'll continue to help us make the Grand Concert a reality!

text_block_list.name: Man in Suit
text_block_list.text: Sure thing. I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Falco, there you are! Is this about that Grand Concert?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Hehe, we want to pitch in too! We actually stopped by your concert the other day, and it made us want to join.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Really?! Welcome aboard! You're one of us now!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you never miss a beat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've had more students join our cause, too.

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: …So those are the people going on about this "Grand Concert"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The student walks off before we get a chance to talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: We let out a sigh unconsciously when our sympathetic nervous system is in control.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why, you ask? Because our blood vessels contract in order to replace low blood oxygen levels.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And why is that? Because we are stressed! That means our bodies tense up and make our breath shallow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Umm, so what are you trying to say?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I simply mean to ask: are you well? You are, after all, a veritable and valuable "well" of potential.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …I really don't get you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Like, that time at the concert…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? I don't think I'm sick or anything, and yet…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Perhaps you feel something is amiss with your legs?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh… But is that feeling danger, or potential that leads to dreams?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The answer… is both. Your speed approaches an unknown that no one else has ever attained.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Should you attempt to reach the domain that lies beyond on your own, you may exceed your "limits."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …What does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I can see it now—you crossing that line will be disadvantageous for the both of us.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now then, as a scientist, allow me to propose that you turn your attention to concerts.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I joined the Grand Concert project like you told me to.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But I still don't get it. I mean, concerts are just… concerts.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: We do them to thank our fans for supporting us in our races.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I know they're a necessary part of racing… but I don't think they have anything to do with my running.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, but they do.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, I know! Why don't you try talking directly with a fan sometime?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Who knows, you might learn a thing or two, including what concerts mean to you.
